import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { Router } from '@angular/router'; import { SalesService } from 'src/app/services/sales.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-payment', templateUrl: './payment.component.html', styleUrls: ['./payment.component.css'], }) export class PaymentComponent implements OnInit { orderData: any = {}; isLoading = false; paymentSuccess = false; totalAmount = 0; constructor( private router: Router, private salesService: SalesService, ) {} ngOnInit(): void { // Get order data from localStorage const savedCart = localStorage.getItem('checkout_cart'); console.log('Raw saved cart:', savedCart); // Debug if (savedCart) { this.orderData = JSON.parse(savedCart); console.log('Parsed orderData:', this.orderData); // Debug // Calculate total amount if (this.orderData.items && this.orderData.items.length > 0) { this.totalAmount = this.orderData.items.reduce( (sum: number, item: any) => { const itemPrice = Number(item.price) || 0; const itemQty = Number(item.quantity) || 1; console.log( `Item: ${item.name}, Price: ${itemPrice}, Qty: ${itemQty}`, ); // Debug return sum + itemPrice * itemQty; }, 0, ); console.log('Total Amount:', this.totalAmount); // Debug } else { console.error('No items in cart'); this.router.navigate(['/cart']); } } else { console.error('No cart data found'); this.router.navigate(['/cart']); } } processPayment(): void { this.isLoading = true; const buyerName = localStorage.getItem('username'); if (!buyerName) { alert('Please login first'); this.router.navigate(['/login']); return; } // Create an order for each item in cart const orders = this.orderData.items?.map((item: any) => { const order = { itemName: item.name, buyer: buyerName, price: Number(item.price) || 0, quantity: Number(item.quantity) || 1, delivered: false, orderStatus: 'PENDING', orderDate: new Date(), shippingAddress: localStorage.getItem('shippingAddress') || 'Not provided', }; console.log('Sending order to backend:', order); // Debug return order; }); if (!orders || orders.length === 0) { alert('No items in cart'); this.router.navigate(['/cart']); return; } let completedOrders = 0; let hasError = false; orders.forEach((order: any) => { this.salesService.createOrder(order).subscribe({ next: (response) => { console.log('Order saved successfully:', response); // Debug completedOrders++; if (completedOrders === orders.length && !hasError) { this.isLoading = false; this.paymentSuccess = true; // Clear cart after successful payment localStorage.removeItem('checkout_cart'); localStorage.removeItem('cart'); setTimeout(() => { this.router.navigate(['/orders'], { queryParams: { payment: 'success' }, }); }, 2000); } }, error: (err) => { console.error('Error placing order:', err); hasError = true; this.isLoading = false; alert('Failed to place order. Please try again.'); }, }); }); } skipPayment(): void { if ( confirm( 'Are you sure you want to go back? Your order will not be placed.', ) ) { this.router.navigate(['/cart']); } } formatPrice(price: number): string { if (!price) return '0'; return price.toLocaleString('en-IN'); } }
